description: CHASE-PL Future Hydrology provides SWAT model inputs, raw simulations and aggregated projections for the Vistula and Odra basins in Poland. The research team archives nine bias-corrected EURO-CORDEX forcings under RCP4.5 and RCP8.5, with reference years 1974–2000 and future periods 2024–2050 and 2074–2100. Streamflow is daily; nine water-balance variables are monthly. 4TU.ResearchData provides free public access under its stated General Terms of Use, with ZIP bundles and geospatial material. The regional release can drive reservoir, irrigation and climate-adaptation simulations. Climate and hydrological model uncertainty limits precise prediction, and the repository points to a partial newer release. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
